mechanism_narrative: Persistent elevation in RESIDENTIAL mobility reflects more time spent at home, which reduces discretionary shopping trips and suppresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week mean while RESIDENTIAL remains above baseline for the next 28 days.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT moves up sharply from one week to the next, commuting access and street exposure increase, and RETAIL_REC rises within two weeks as trips combine with shopping visits.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT rises by at least 3 points week-on-week after a prior two-week increase
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT increased from 1.1 at t-2w to 5.1 at t-1w and remained above baseline at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase within 14 days after a confirmed TRANSIT jump of at least 3 points.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT indicates a commuting rebound that compounds weekday foot traffic, pushing RETAIL_REC higher over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC fails to outperform its last four-week mean even though WORKPLACES and TRANSIT both trend upward for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: When GROCERY_PHARM stays above baseline while PARKS stay weak, shopping remains utilitarian rather than discretionary, limiting spillover into leisure retail and keeping RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remain below -15 points while GROCERY_PHARM stays positive for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its prior four-week mean despite the simultaneous high-GROCERY_PHARM / low-PARKS pattern.

mechanism_narrative: A renewed transit recovery only converts into retail gains when workplaces are also rising; if transit improves without workplace attendance, RETAIL_REC does not lift over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT and WORKPLACES both rise above their t-2w levels
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT moved from 1.1 at t-2w to 5.1 at t-1w while WORKPLACES improved from -6.3 to -2.9
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not increase over 28 days when both TRANSIT and WORKPLACES are above their two-week-ago levels.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained PARKS weakness signals poor outdoor conditions or seasonal suppression of leisure activity, which spills into discretionary shopping and lowers RETAIL_REC over the next month.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC increases over the next 28 days while PARKS remains below -15 points.

mechanism_narrative: If RESIDENTIAL rises above its recent range while WORKPLACES stays depressed, people substitute toward home-based activity and postpone discretionary outings, so RETAIL_REC falls within two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL exceeds 5 points and WORKPLACES stays below -5 points
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL was 5.9 at t-2w and 5.4 at t-0w while WORKPLACES stayed negative
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC does not drop within 14 days after the residential-high / workplace-low condition appears.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT is positive for multiple weeks but WORKPLACES do not recover, mobility reflects non-work movement that does not translate into retail demand, leaving RETAIL_REC flat or lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT stays above 0 while WORKPLACES remain below 0 for at least two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above its last four-week mean despite positive TRANSIT and negative WORKPLACES persisting for two weeks.
